title: cde_classification
description: A CDE's recommendation in a situation — one row per (cde_key x steward_org x context x sub_context x population). The five scoping columns are the identity. A WILDCARD value '*' means 'applies to ALL values of this axis' (leave the cell blank in the source sheet; the importer stores '*'). So a row with sub_context='*' applies to the whole context, and population='*' applies to every population. When a CDE lands on a form, it takes the MOST SPECIFIC matching row — the one with the fewest wildcards that the form still satisfies (a wildcard matches anything; a concrete value must equal the form's). `tier` is the recommendation level; null when the steward has no tier concept. This flat shape replaces the earlier coordinate/facets encoding: everything a curator enters is a plain column.

cde_key.description: The classified CDE's key (matches cde.cde_key; also the CLASSIFIES relationship target). Part of the identity.

steward_org.description: The classifying authority (NINDS, PhenX, NHLBI, PROMIS, ...). May differ from the CDE's own steward. Part of the identity.

context.description: Top scope: the disease / study / collection this recommendation is for (e.g. 'Traumatic Brain Injury', 'Epilepsy', 'Project 5 (COVID-19)'). Part of the identity. '*' = all contexts (rare).

sub_context.description: Second scope: the clinical scenario / severity / phase within the context (e.g. 'Acute Hospitalized', 'Comprehensive', 'Concussion/Mild TBI'). Part of the identity. '*' = applies to the whole context (no scenario distinction).

population.description: Applicability scope: the population the recommendation is for (e.g. 'Adult', 'Pediatric'). Part of the identity. '*' = applies to every population.

domain.description: Descriptive area — the steward's top-level Domain for this CDE (e.g. 'Assessments and Examinations'). NOT part of the identity; a browse/display column. Null when the steward has no Domain axis.

tier.description: The recommendation level at this scope (NINDS 'Core' / 'Supplemental - Highly Recommended' / 'Supplemental' / 'Exploratory'; NLM 'Tier 1'/'Tier 2'; PTE 'Basic'/'Recommended'). Free string, not a hard enum. Null when the steward has no tier concept.
